name: @sand/jobs
description: Background jobs: agents, workflows and shell commands that run on after the tool call returns

sand.label: Background jobs
sand.summary: Tracks background agents, workflows and shell commands, tells the agent when they finish, and lets it read, message, wait for and stop them

uses.ui: there is no /agents command and results that cannot be delivered fail silently
uses.steering: results for subagents start a new turn instead of joining the running one
uses.server: the page cannot list or stop background jobs
